title: Long Beach Watersports - Jet Ski Rentals

services.name: Jetskis by the Hour
services.desc: If you're looking for a Long Beach adventure and just can't commit an entire day, then Long Beach Watersports has what you need with their hourly jetski rentals. Whether you're on a really tight schedule or just want to fit some fun in on a break, renting a jetski for 1, 2, or 3 hours gives you the freedom to enjoy open water without the time commitment of a full-day rental. One of the main advantages of hourly rentals is being able to choose the rental time that best fits your day. If someone just wants a quick spin to get the feel of the water, a one-hour rental is perfect. Enjoy a sail along the coastline, relish beautiful views of the city, and get an introduction to the adventure
